bounded_interpretation.observation: The branches are identical immediately before recorded Start, diverge at the immediate post-input PC, and by the final sample only the Start-removed branch retains FMV.BIN at region B.
bounded_interpretation.inference: Fresh Start is a native FMV skip input for this inspected pristine anchor.
bounded_interpretation.causal_confirmation: Only nine ports.0.start samples differ; every retained coverage branch is cycle/RAM/register/frame neutral against its own control.
bounded_interpretation.forbidden_claim: Three natural cold-boot streams and one state-anchored clip do not close every manifest entry, movie viewer, pause/stop, stream/decode error, level transition or frontend ownership boundary.

bounded_open_frontier.natural_completion: Closed for neutral cold-boot dlogo/title/intro only; level-owned and viewer-owned natural completion remain separate breadth work.
bounded_open_frontier.breadth: Replay representative level A/B, alternate, lose and movie-viewer owners for the 36 manifest entries without live evidence.
bounded_open_frontier.exceptional_paths: Capture decode timeout/CD failure and pause/stop behavior without manufacturing success.
bounded_open_frontier.next_experiment: Use existing end-of-level/menu movies to bind one natural level-B transition and one movie-viewer selection, then test pause/stop/reuse.
